text: APPROVE. The extracted `TryEnumerate` helper keeps the same try/catch (IOException and UnauthorizedAccessException), the same materialisation and the same `continue` on failure. That removes the four catch clauses from the loop, which by my count takes the method from 17 to about 13. The nullable annotations, the preserved `CHA0004` pragma and the lambda's capture of the loop-local `dir` in an iterator should all compile cleanly, but I did not build it.
